title: BERTScore is Unfair: On Social Bias in Language Model-Based Metrics for Text Generation
findings: PLM-based evaluation metrics (like BERTScore, BLEURT, BARTScore) exhibit significantly higher religious bias than traditional n-gram-based metrics (like BLEU, ROUGE). For the 'religion' attribute, PLM-based metrics showed bias scores ranging from approximately 4.6 to 17.1 on a 100-point scale, while traditional metrics scored below 4.1.

measurement_description: The paper measures social bias in text generation evaluation metrics. For religion, it evaluates whether metrics assign different scores to two minimally different sentences, where one contains a religious stereotype and the other an anti-stereotype, based on datasets constructed from the CrowS-Pairs corpus.
